[USER] User is transferring multimedia files from their computer to their PSP.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] You can transfer multimedia files from your computer to your PSP by following these steps:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Connect your PSP to your computer using a USB cable.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Turn on your PSP and select USB Connection under the Settings menu.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. On your computer, open File Explorer and navigate to the folder where your multimedia files are stored.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Select the files you want to transfer to your PSP and drag them to the PSP's folder named PSP.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Once the transfer is complete, disconnect your PSP from the computer and go to the folder where you saved the files on your PSP.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Use the appropriate application on your PSP to access or play the multimedia files you transferred.
